gaps.message: AC-N6.2 says no layer other than repository may import sqlalchemy, yet models and migrations must import it. SAD.md §5 line 469 resolves this by naming api, service, config and errors as forbidden sources. It is flagged as Requires Verification, and the SAB nfr_traceability NFR-06 target text 'forbidden outside repository' is slightly looser than that resolution.
SAD.md notes that SPEC.md has no section 6 (directory structure), so the module tree is derived rather than quoted. It is marked Unknown and needs confirmation from the SPEC owner.
The NFR-11 SAB target omits the MI >= 80 criterion (AC-N11.1) and lists only CC, file size and directory size. It is harmless but incomplete.
